description: Shared rules come from the preset npm-dev in MisterJB/renovate-bot (schedule, groups, automerge, majors via Dependency Dashboard, Node group, useBaseBranchConfig merge). Only project rules here. Tool versions: node from .node-version, npm from packageManager in package.json (npm 11 like the lockfile author; npm 10 fails on the $postcss override reference during lockfile updates). Background: docs/dev/renovate.md.

packageRules.description: Paused, see ISS-005: needs vite 8, the test runner allows only up to vite 7 (ERESOLVE). Stays visible in the Dependency Dashboard; do not approve before ISS-005 is resolved, then remove this rule.
Paused, see ISS-006: typescript-eslint allows TypeScript only up to 6.0, the lockfile fails (ERESOLVE) and lint aborts. Remove this rule once typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
Paused, see ISS-007: npm 12 refuses the @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi tarball while regenerating the lockfile (EALLOWREMOTE). packageManager stays on npm 11 until that is solved.
